page_title: Superagent, a home for your agent

summary.name: Superagent
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source Mac app that hosts coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity) with a built-in browser they can drive, an iOS Simulator pane, persistent chats, and an optional iPhone companion app.
keywords: agent running on my mac from phone
use_cases: Run coding agents on a Mac with separate chats per task
Let an agent work on a git branch without touching your checkout
Test a website or iPhone app in a simulator driven by an agent
Automate tasks in a browser you are already signed in to
Approve or direct a running agent from an iPhone
Compare or preview a web page on desktop and phone viewports
summary.what_it_does: Superagent is a Mac app where coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity run in a sidebar of persistent chats, each with its own context. Each chat can run on its own git worktree and branch, so the user's checkout stays unchanged. The app includes a browser pane the agent can drive using the user's own signed-in sessions, plus a streamed iOS Simulator pane that the agent can tap, type and swipe in. Notifications appear when an agent finishes or asks for approval, and an optional iPhone app pairs with the Mac via QR code and an end-to-end encrypted relay.
notable: Git worktree chats: each chat commits to its own branch, leaving the main checkout untouched
Built-in browser and iOS Simulator the agent can drive, using your own logged-in sessions
Optional iPhone app paired by QR code, with end-to-end encrypted relay that can be self-hosted
Open source under MIT, signed and notarized by Apple, no account or telemetry
caveats: Requires an existing subscription or agent such as Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity; the agent talks to its maker directly
Split view and the dot feature are marked as beta; split view is Mac and iPad only
Download listed as Apple Silicon only
